products.name: Plum 5% Glycolic Acid & Goji Berry Exfoliating Toner
products.short_description: Plum 5% Glycolic Acid & Goji Berry Exfoliating Toner gently exfoliates to help smooth rough texture, unclog pores, and improve dull-looking skin. Formulated with 5% Glycolic Acid and Goji Berry for a smoother, brighter-looking complexion.

Plum 5% Glycolic Acid & Goji Berry Exfoliating Toner is a gentle exfoliating toner designed to improve the appearance of textured, dull, and uneven-looking skin. Formulated with 5% Glycolic Acid and Goji Berry, it helps gently remove dead skin cells, refine skin texture, and reveal a smoother, brighter-looking complexion over time.

The exfoliating formula helps unclog pores and reduce the appearance of congestion while supporting smoother-looking skin. It is a great addition to a skincare routine focused on improving rough texture and dullness.

Key Benefits:

• Contains 5% Glycolic Acid

• Helps smooth rough and bumpy skin texture

• Helps remove dead skin cells

• Helps unclog pores and reduce congestion

• Helps improve dull-looking skin

• Promotes a brighter, smoother-looking complexion

• Formulated with Goji Berry

• Helps reduce post-exfoliation dryness

The lightweight toner helps replenish moisture, soothe the skin, and support a balanced-looking complexion. Regular use can also help minimize the appearance of pores, making it an easy addition to your daily skincare routine.

• Helps plump and refresh the skin

• Soothes and balances the skin

• Helps maintain skin pH balance

• Helps minimize the appearance of pores

• Alcohol-free formula

• Suitable for daily use

• Leaves skin feeling fresh and comfortable

The sheer tint helps provide a subtle, natural-looking finish, making it suitable for everyday use when you want lightweight coverage without the feel of a heavy base. Its skin-friendly formula can be easily incorporated into your morning skincare and makeup routine.

Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum with Mandarin 30ml is a brightening face serum designed to give your skin a fresh, radiant-looking appearance. Formulated with 15% Vitamin C and Mandarin, it is a great addition to a skincare routine focused on improving dull-looking skin and boosting glow.

Its lightweight serum texture makes it easy to apply and layer with the rest of your skincare routine. For best use, apply a few drops to clean skin and gently pat it into the face and neck.

Key Benefits:

• Contains 15% Vitamin C

• Helps brighten dull-looking skin

• Promotes a fresh, radiant-looking glow

• Lightweight serum texture

• Easy to layer into your daily skincare routine

• Suitable for use on the face and neck

• Comes with a convenient dropper applicator

products.name: Dr.Althea PDRN Reju 5000 Cream
products.short_description: Dr.Althea PDRN Reju 5000 Cream is a lightweight, nourishing face cream with 5,000 ppm probiotic-derived vegan PDRN that hydrates dry, dull-looking skin and leaves it feeling soft, comfortable, and fresh with a healthy-looking glow.
products.description:
Dr.Althea PDRN Reju 5000 Cream is a nourishing face cream designed for dry, dull-looking skin that needs moisture, softness, and a healthy-looking glow. Formulated with 5,000 ppm probiotic-derived vegan PDRN from five fermented ingredients, it helps replenish moisture and leave the skin feeling comfortable and hydrated.

The lightweight, layerable texture provides nourishing hydration without leaving a heavy or greasy finish. You can adjust the amount based on your skin’s needs, making it suitable for everyday moisturizing and more intensive hydration when your skin feels dry or uncomfortable.

products.name: Dr. Althea Melaclear Cream
products.short_description: Dr. Althea Melaclear Cream is a brightening face cream with tranexamic acid and niacinamide that helps improve the appearance of dark spots, post-blemish marks, and uneven skin tone while keeping skin moisturized.
products.description:
Dr. Althea Melaclear Cream is a brightening face cream formulated with tranexamic acid and niacinamide to help improve the appearance of dark spots, post-blemish marks, and uneven-looking skin tone. Its moisturizing formula provides brightening care while helping keep the skin feeling soft and hydrated.

With a lightweight cream-to-serum texture, Dr. Althea Melaclear Cream can be applied directly to specific areas of discoloration or used as an overnight brightening moisture layer for more intensive care.

products.name: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Baume B5+
products.short_description: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Baume B5+ is a multi-purpose repairing balm that soothes, protects, and helps restore irritated, dry, or weakened skin. With a nourishing, non-greasy texture, it can be used on the face, body, and lips by the whole
products.description:
La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Baume B5+ is a dermatologist-tested, multi-purpose repairing balm designed to soothe, protect, and restore irritated or weakened skin. Suitable for the whole family, this nourishing balm helps support skin barrier recovery while providing comfort to dry, sensitive, and irritated skin.

Formulated for everyday skin repair, Cicaplast Baume B5+ helps soothe redness, dryness, irritation, and discomfort while protecting the skin with a nourishing yet non-greasy, fast-absorbing texture.

This versatile repair balm can be used on the face, body, and lips and is suitable for various skin concerns, including burns, mosquito bites, post-procedure skin, and nappy rash.

products.name: CeraVe Invisible Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
products.short_description: CeraVe Invisible Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 provides lightweight, hydrating broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection with a more transparent finish across a wide range of skin tones. Suitable for sensitive and acne-prone skin, its mineral formula gl
products.description:
CeraVe Invisible Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is a lightweight, hydrating mineral sunscreen designed to provide broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays. Formulated with CeraVe’s miner-ALL technology, it is designed to leave a more transparent finish across a wide range of skin tones and types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.

Its weightless formula glides smoothly onto the skin without feeling heavy, making it suitable for everyday sun protection. The sunscreen is also designed to blend more transparently on beards, making it a convenient option for a wide range of users.

products.name: Loreal Professionnel Serie Expert Liss Unlimited Mask
products.short_description: Smoothing hair mask for rebellious hair. Blocks humidity to control frizz, adds shine, and leaves hair smooth and manageable. Ideal for all hair types, especially rebellious or straightened hair.
products.description:
Tame rebellious, frizz-prone hair with L’Oréal Professionnel Serie Expert Liss Unlimited Masque. This luxurious smoothing mask nourishes and coats each hair fiber, polishing its surface while forming an effective barrier against humidity — so your style stays smooth even in humid conditions.

Hair is left bathed in hydration, with enhanced shine and regained control over frizz. The result is smoother, more manageable hair that resists humidity-triggered puffiness, making it a great fit for anyone with unruly, frizz-prone, or straightened hair looking to maintain a sleek finish.

Key Benefits:

Anti-frizz protection

Purifies and smoothens hair fiber

Effective humidity blocker

Enhanced shine

Nourishes and hydrates hair

products.name: Loreal Professionnel Serie Expert Inforcer Shampoo
products.short_description: Strengthening anti-breakage shampoo with Vitamin B6 & Biotin. Delivers up to 8X less breakage with continued use, leaving hair stronger, smoother, and more resistant to damage. Ideal for weak, breakage-prone hair.
products.description:
Reinforce weak, breakage-prone hair with L’Oréal Professionnel Serie Expert Inforcer Shampoo. Formulated with Vitamin B6 and Biotin, this strengthening shampoo works to reduce breakage instantly while nourishing each hair strand from root to tip for healthier, more resilient hair.

Vitamin B6 strengthens hair follicles from within, while Biotin nourishes the scalp and supports stronger, thicker hair growth. Together, they help restore your hair’s natural vitality, resulting in noticeably less breakage and improved overall strength.

With consistent use, hair becomes up to 8X more resistant to breakage, softer, smoother, and easier to manage — with reduced tangling for a smoother, hassle-free styling experience every time.

Key Benefits:

• Up to 8X less breakage with continued use*

• Strengthens hair from root to tip

• Improved hydration and nourishment

• Softer, smoother, more manageable hair

• Easier combing, reduced tangling

• Infused with Vitamin B6 & Biotin

products.name: Loreal Professionnel Serie Expert Inforcer Mask
products.short_description: Reinforcing hair mask with Vitamin B6 & Biotin for instant reduced breakage and intense conditioning. Strengthens hair, making it more resistant with continued use. Ideal for weak, breakage-prone hair.
products.description:
Give your hair the strength it needs with L’Oréal Professionnel Serie Expert Inforcer Mask. This indulgent reinforcing formula is infused with Vitamin B6 and Biotin, working to instantly reduce breakage while delivering intense conditioning from root to tip.

With continued use, hair becomes noticeably more resistant and stronger, better equipped to handle daily styling and stress. The rich, conditioning texture leaves hair feeling nourished, smooth, and more resilient — perfect for anyone dealing with weak, fragile, or breakage-prone hair.

Instantly reduces hair breakage

Infused with Vitamin B6 & Biotin

Intense conditioning action

Strengthens and reinforces hair with continued use

Ideal for weak, fragile hair

products.name: Loreal Professionnel Serie Expert Vitamino Color Resveratrol Masque 250ml
products.short_description: Color-protecting mask with Resveratrol & Panthenol for salon-colored hair. Delivers up to 8 weeks of color protection and 5X more shine, while strengthening hair from roots to tips.
products.description:
Keep your salon-colored hair vibrant and healthy with L’Oréal Professionnel Serie Expert Vitamino Color Mask. Infused with Resveratrol, Panthenol, and other nourishing ingredients, this color radiance mask gently cleanses impurities while giving your color-treated hair the protection it needs to stay radiant for longer.

Its creamy texture transforms into a rich foam on application, working to strengthen the hair fiber from roots to tips while helping to lock in color vibrancy. With regular use, hair looks more radiant, feels stronger, and holds onto its salon color longer between treatments.

Key Benefits:

• Up to 8 weeks of color protection*

• 5X more shine

• Strengthens hair fiber from roots to tips

• Creamy-to-foam texture for gentle, effective cleansing

• Infused with Resveratrol & Panthenol

*Instrumental test: shampoo + mask vs. non-conditioning shampoo, used with the nourishing L’Oréal Professionnel Vitamino Color mask.

products.name: Loreal Professionnel Serie Expert Absolut Repair Mask – With Protein & Omega-9
products.short_description: Deep-repair hair mask powered by Protein & Omega-9. Strengthens damaged hair fiber, boosts shine, and leaves hair soft and lightweight with up to 13X more resistance. Vegan formula.
products.description:
Give damaged hair the intensive care it needs with L’Oréal Professionnel Serie Expert Absolut Repair Mask. Formulated with Protein & Omega-9, this expert nourishing mask works deep within the hair fiber to repair damage, restore strength, and lock in hydration — leaving hair soft, smooth, and visibly healthier with every use.

Regular use helps hair withstand daily stress and styling damage, while enhancing natural shine and manageability. The lightweight formula absorbs easily without weighing hair down, making it suitable for regular use on dry, brittle, or chemically treated hair.

Key Benefits:

• Up to 13X more resistance to damage

• Boosts hair shine

• Lightweight, non-greasy finish

• Softer, smoother hair with continued use

• Vegan formula — no animal-derived ingredients or by-products

products.name: Banana Boat Kids Sensitive Mineral Based Sunscreen
products.short_description: Gentle mineral sunscreen made for kids’ sensitive skin. SPF 50 PA+++ broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection, waterproof and sweat-resistant, with no eye-stinging formula. Free from oxybenzone, parabens, oils, and added fragrance.
products.description:
Keep your little ones protected during every outdoor adventure with Banana Boat Kids Sensitive Mineral Based Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++. Specially formulated for children’s delicate skin, this mineral-based sunscreen offers powerful broad-spectrum protection against both UVA and UVB rays, helping shield young skin from sunburn and long-term sun damage.

Unlike many regular sunscreens, this gentle formula won’t sting or irritate the eyes, making it ideal for active kids who run, swim, and play without a break. It’s highly water-resistant and sweat-proof, so protection stays strong through swimming, sports, and hot, humid days.

Formulated with 25% fewer chemicals and free from oxybenzone, parabens, added oils, and perfumes, it’s a safer choice for sensitive young skin. Suitable for use on both the face and body, it blends easily and is designed for everyday outdoor use — beach days, school sports, or simple playtime outside.

Key Highlights:

• SPF 50 PA+++ broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection

• Mineral-based, gentle sensitive-skin formula

• No eye-stinging, kid-friendly application

• Waterproof and sweat-resistant

• 25% fewer chemicals

• Free from oxybenzone, parabens, oils, and perfume

• Safe for face and body use

products.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Waterproof Mascara
products.short_description: Achieve sky-high, dramatic lashes with Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Waterproof Mascara. This buildable formula is infused with nourishing bamboo extract and fibres for fuller, longer-looking lashes. Lightweight, flake-free, and wate
products.description:
Elevate your lash game with Maybelline’s Lash Sensational Sky High Waterproof Mascara — designed to deliver dramatic, sky-high length and volume without the weight. Whether you’re after a natural everyday look or bold, voluminous lashes, this buildable formula adapts to your desired intensity.

Key Benefits:

• Bamboo Extract & Fibre-Infused Formula: Nourishes lashes while building fullness and length with every coat, for a fuller, more voluminous lash line.

• Limitless Lengthening & Volume: The uniquely designed brush captures and coats lashes from root to tip, reaching even the shortest and hardest-to-reach hairs from every angle.

• Lightweight, Non-Weighing Formula: Delivers big, bold volume without feeling heavy or clumpy, so lashes stay lifted and comfortable all day.

• Richly Pigmented, Flake-Free Colour: Intense, true black pigment glides on smoothly and stays put without flaking or smudging.

• Defining, Curling & Multiplying Effect: Separates and curls each lash while visually multiplying lash density for a fuller fringe.

• Waterproof Formula: Long-lasting wear that resists smudging, sweat, humidity, and tears — ideal for all-day and all-weather confidence.

Who It’s For:

Suitable for all lash types, this mascara is perfect for anyone wanting buildable, customizable volume and length — from a subtle daytime flutter to a bold, statement-making lash look.

How to Use:

Starting at the base of your lashes, wiggle the brush upward through to the tips. Layer additional coats for extra volume and length, allowing lashes to dry slightly between applications for maximum buildability.

products.name: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream With Pump 453g
products.short_description: Hydrate and repair your skin barrier with CeraVe Moisturizing Cream (453g). Formulated with 3 essential ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and MVE Technology for 24-hour moisture release. Non-greasy, fragrance-free, and dermatologist-developed for
products.description:
Give your skin the deep, lasting hydration it deserves with CeraVe Moisturizing Cream. Developed alongside dermatologists, this rich yet non-greasy formula is designed to restore and maintain your skin’s natural protective barrier while delivering intense moisture that lasts all day and night.

Key Benefits:

• 3 Essential Ceramides (1, 3, 6-II): Help restore and strengthen the skin’s natural barrier, protecting against moisture loss and environmental stressors.

• Hyaluronic Acid: Attracts and retains moisture, keeping skin plump, smooth, and hydrated.

• MVE Technology: A patented time-release delivery system that continuously releases moisturizing ingredients over 24 hours, so you’re not constantly reapplying.

• Non-Greasy, Fast-Absorbing Formula: Sinks in quickly without leaving a heavy or oily residue, making it comfortable for everyday wear.

• Fragrance-Free: Gentle enough for sensitive skin, with no added fragrances that could cause irritation.

Who It’s For:

Ideal for those with dry to very dry skin, this versatile cream can be used on both the face and body. Its gentle, dermatologist-approved formula helps soothe dryness, calm irritation, and support overall skin health — making it suitable for daily use by the whole family.

Why Choose the Pump Format:

The 453g pump dispenser makes application easy, hygienic, and mess-free — perfect for daily use in the bathroom or by the bedside, ensuring you get the right amount every time without waste.

How to Use:

Apply liberally to face and body as often as needed, especially after bathing or showering, to lock in moisture and keep skin feeling soft, smooth, and comfortable throughout the day.

products.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Washable Mascara
products.short_description: Get limitless length and full volume with Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Washable Mascara. The Flex Tower brush bends to coat every lash from root to tip, while the bamboo and fiber-infused formula delivers a lightweight, buildable lo
products.description:
Reach new heights with the Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Washable Mascara — a formula built to give your lashes dramatic length, full volume, and stunning definition from every angle. At the heart of this mascara is the exclusive Flex Tower brush, designed to flex and bend as you apply, ensuring every lash — even the hard-to-reach corner lashes — gets evenly coated with pigment from base to tip.

Infused with bamboo extract and fine fibers, the lightweight formula wraps each lash for visible length without weighing them down or feeling stiff. The intensely pigmented ‘Very Black’ shade delivers bold, impactful color for a striking, wide-eyed look that lasts all day.

Best of all, this mascara is fully washable — no harsh rubbing, no makeup remover needed. Just rinse with warm water for effortless, gentle removal that’s kind to your lashes.

Key Highlights:

Exclusive Flex Tower brush bends to coat every lash

Bamboo extract and fiber-infused formula for lightweight length

Rich, pigmented ‘Very Black’ shade for bold definition

Washable formula rinses away cleanly with water alone

products.name: Bellaoggi Moisturising Lotion
products.short_description: Bellaoggi Moisturising Lotion is a rich, thick fluid that instantly hydrates the skin, leaving it soft, firm and radiant. Ideal for daily face and neck care.
products.description:
Bellaoggi Moisturising Lotion is a rich, thick fluid formulated to hydrate the skin immediately on application. Lightweight yet nourishing, it leaves the complexion feeling soft, looking firm, and visibly radiant with regular use.

Designed for daily use on the face and neck, this lotion works to replenish moisture and support a healthy, glowing appearance, making it an easy addition to any skincare routine.

Key Features:

Instant Hydration — rich, thick formula absorbs to moisturise on contact

Soft, Firm Skin — supports a smoother, firmer-looking complexion

Radiant Finish — leaves skin looking healthy and glowing

Face & Neck Use — suitable for daily application

How to Use:

Apply to the face and neck using a cotton pad or directly with the fingers, patting gently. Avoid the eye contour area.

products.name: Bellaoggi Lumi Gloss
products.short_description: Bellaoggi Lumi Gloss is a universal top coat that adds a shimmering, three-dimensional finish to any lipstick. Non-sticky and enriched with Vitamin E, Omega 3 and Omega 6, it hydrates lips while delivering a high-shine, glam sparkle.
products.description:
Bellaoggi Lumi Gloss is a brand-new universal top coat designed to give any lipstick a fresh shimmer finish, making lips ultra-glam and sparkling. It works as the perfect finishing touch to bring new light to the lips, emphasize colour, and enhance volume.

Formulated with a non-sticky texture and a very high emollient power, Lumi Gloss is enriched with Vitamin E, Omega 3 and Omega 6 to hydrate and protect the lips with every application. Worn alone, it delivers a touch of light with a three-dimensional effect and a super-shiny finish.

Sweetly scented with vanilla, Lumi Gloss features an extremely flexible texture that allows for a modulated colour effect — choose between pure luminosity or full coverage of reflective pearls, depending on the look you’re after. For lips that are highly seductive and irresistibly glossy, this lip topper is the finishing step every lipstick collection needs.

Key Features:

Universal Top Coat — layers over any lipstick shade

Non-Sticky Formula — comfortable, high-emollient texture

Hydrating & Protective — enriched with Vitamin E, Omega 3 & Omega 6

3D Shine Effect — super-glossy, reflective finish

Customisable Coverage — from sheer luminosity to full pearl reflection

Vanilla Scented — subtly sweet fragrance

How to Use:

Apply over your favourite lipstick shade, or wear alone for a glossy, shimmering finish.

products.name: Bellaoggi Color Pump
products.short_description: Bellaoggi Color Pump lipstick delivers richly pigmented colour in a smooth jelly texture with a non-sticky, high-shine finish. From vibrant nudes to bold berry reds, this long-lasting lipstick glides on for precise, smudge-proof application
products.description:
Bellaoggi Color Pump lipstick is formulated to deliver bold, richly pigmented colour in every swipe. With shades ranging from vibrant nudes to striking berry reds, this lipstick offers true-to-tone colour payoff that stands out beautifully, even on darker complexions.

Its bold yet supple jelly texture glides on effortlessly, adhering smoothly to the lips for a flawless, smoothing effect. Lips appear wrapped in a plastic-smooth film of pure, rich colour, finished with a radiance that’s genuinely unrivalled.

Housed in Bellaoggi’s sleek, fashion-forward Stylo packaging, this lipstick adds a touch of extravagance to any makeup collection, capturing a playful yet elegant spirit made for bold, confident femininity.

Key Features:

Highly Pigmented — intense colour payoff in one swipe

Precise Application — no smudge, clean lines every time

Jelly Texture — lightweight, comfortable, non-sticky feel

Super Shiny Finish — high-gloss radiance that lasts

Long-Lasting Wear — colour that stays vibrant all day

How to Use:

Start at the upper edge of the lips from the centre, then glide along the contour to shape as desired.

products.name: Loreal Bonjour Sunshine
products.short_description: Get a natural, sun-kissed glow all year round with L’Oréal Bonjour Sunshine Liquid Bronzer. Its lightweight gel texture blends effortlessly, delivering a warm, radiant finish while keeping your skin hydrated for up to 24 hours. With SPF 22
products.description:
Wake up your skin with a healthy, sun-kissed glow using L’Oréal Bonjour Sunshine Liquid Bronzer. Designed with a lightweight gel texture, this innovative bronzer provides an instant bronze effect without any self-tanning ingredients, making it perfect for daily use.

You can apply it all over your face for a soft, radiant glow or use it to sculpt and contour your natural features. The universal shade adapts beautifully to all skin tones, giving a natural, warm finish that mimics a subtle sun exposure.

Enriched with coconut extract, the formula not only enhances your complexion but also keeps your skin moisturized for up to 24 hours. With added SPF 22, it offers light sun protection, making it an ideal addition to your everyday makeup routine.

products.name: Cetaphil Moisturizing Cream Ultimate
products.short_description: Rich, long-lasting hydration cream that soothes and protects dry, sensitive skin. Lightweight, non-irritating formula with prebiotic aloe keeps skin soft and comfortable for up to 48 hours.
products.description:
Cetaphil Moisturizing Cream Ultimate is designed to deeply hydrate and protect dry, sensitive skin. It provides up to 48 hours of continuous moisture, helping restore the skin’s natural barrier while giving instant relief from dryness and tightness.

Formulated with prebiotic aloe and antioxidants, it supports healthy skin and defends against common signs of sensitivity such as irritation, roughness, and weakened skin barrier. The gentle, hypoallergenic formula is free from parabens and fragrance, making it suitable for everyday use without causing irritation.

Its non-comedogenic texture absorbs easily without clogging pores, leaving skin smooth, soft, and well-nourished.

products.name: LA Colors Gel Eyeliner
products.short_description: L.A. Colors Gel Eyeliner offers bold color with a creamy, gel-like finish. It glides smoothly without tugging, delivers long-lasting, smudge-proof wear, and can be sharpened for precise lines or blended for a smoky look. Available in classi
products.description:
L.A. Colors Gel Eyeliner combines the control of a pencil with the rich intensity of a gel. Its smooth, creamy texture glides effortlessly on the eyelids, allowing you to create sharp lines, bold wings, or soft smoky looks before it sets. Once dry, the formula becomes smudge-proof and long-wearing, making it ideal for day-to-night makeup that stays put without fading.

With a selection of metallic, neon, and classic shades, this eyeliner lets you match your mood, elevate simple looks, or experiment with creative styles. The plastic pencil is easily sharpenable, ensuring a precise tip every time. Affordable, pigmented, and versatile, it’s a must-have for anyone who loves long-lasting and impactful eye makeup.

products.name: Skin1004 Tea-Trica Purifying Toner 210ml
products.short_description: Skin1004 Tea-Trica Purifying Toner is a refreshing exfoliating toner for oily and acne-prone skin. Formulated with Tea Tree, Pine Complex, and soothing Centella, it helps remove dead skin cells, control excess sebum, and calm irritation for

Its plant-based CS-Sebum Cleaner controls oil production, while BHA deeply exfoliates and unclogs pores, removing dead skin cells and impurities. With added Centella Asiatica extract, the toner soothes irritation and strengthens sensitive skin. Dermatologically tested to be non-comedogenic and hypoallergenic, it leaves your skin refreshed, balanced, and visibly clearer without irritation.

products.name: Loreal Infallible 24H Oil Killer High Coverage Compact Powder
products.short_description: L’Oréal Infallible 24H Oil Killer High Coverage Compact Powder provides all-day oil control with a smooth, matte finish. Lightweight, water-proof, heat-proof, and non-comedogenic, it blurs pores, lightens dark spots, and offers SPF32 protec
products.description:
Achieve a flawless, matte complexion with L’Oréal Infallible 24H Oil Killer High Coverage Compact Powder. Specially designed for all-day oil control, this powder delivers a smooth, perfecting finish while keeping your skin comfortable and breathable—even under a mask. Powered by micro-pigments, it blurs pores and helps lighten dark spots for a radiant, even-toned look.

Its lightweight formula is water-proof, heat-proof, and humidity-proof, ensuring long-lasting wear in any condition. With low transfer on masks and SPF32, PA +++ protection, it safeguards your skin from sun damage while maintaining a fresh matte appearance. Suitable for all skin types, particularly oily and sensitive skin, this non-comedogenic compact powder is your perfect everyday companion for a flawless, shine-free look.

products.name: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Cream – 75ML
products.short_description: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Cream – 75ML is a lightweight, soothing moisturizer enriched with Madagascar Centella Asiatica and plant-based ceramides. It calms irritated skin, strengthens the skin barrier, and delivers lasting hydration for
products.description: Experience the ultimate skin-soothing care with SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Cream – 75ML. This potent moisturizer is formulated with the healing power of Madagascar Centella Asiatica, known for calming irritation and promoting a healthy complexion. Infused with four types of plant-based ceramides, it helps strengthen your skin barrier and lock in essential moisture, preventing dryness and sensitivity. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly, leaving your skin smooth, soft, and nourished without any heavy residue. Free from parabens, sulfates, artificial fragrances, and harsh chemicals, this cream is gentle enough for all skin types, including sensitive skin, making it a perfect addition to your daily skincare routine.

products.name: Bella Vita Luxury Rose Woman Perfume for Women
products.short_description: Bella Vita Luxury Rose Woman Perfume is a graceful blend of floral and woody notes that celebrates femininity, charm, and romance. Its captivating rose essence leaves an irresistible scent that lingers all day, defining timeless elegance.
products.description: Rose Woman by Bella Vita Luxury captures the true spirit of love and timeless romance. Crafted with elegant floral and sensual woody tones, this perfume exudes sophistication and grace.
